chains.description: --report --scopes: the root-to-folder sums a tool loads

bytes.description: the chain's sum; the object also lists "parts", the bytes of each file

files.description: --report --scopes: one row per generated file per tool

line_forms.description: --report: the entries written as one line, and why

must_line.description: --report: must rules written as one line

profile.description: --report: the tool profile whose budget applies (the smallest of the targets)

tails_left_out.description: --report: tail blocks left out for lack of room

warn_at_percent.description: --report: the warn level, percent of the budget

output.description: a run or --dry-run: the command's lines (the --dry-run body)

profile.description: --trend: the tool profile whose budget applies

reaches_budget.description: --trend: YYYY-MM-DD when LORE.md reaches its budget at this rate

renders.description: --trend: bytes per render over the last 14 days
